column1: # vmq SSH address list (lib/vmq.zsh vmq_ssh_opts). Copy to hosts.tsv in the data folder (vmq paths), or set VMQ_HOSTS_FILE.
# One Mac per line, tab-separated: <identity address>
# The identity address is the second column of resources.tsv and the known_hosts key. When another address answers,
# vmq connects to it with HostKeyAlias=<identity address>, so the same host key is checked.
